title: 2022 Panini Score Football - PROtential RC Rookie - Kenny Pickett #P-KP
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
For avid collectors and fans of the Pitt Panthers, this 2022 Panini Score Football card is a must-have. Featuring the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) star Kenny Pickett, this card is from the 2022 Score set and is part of the Protential insert set. The card is a parallel/variety, rookie, and insert, making it a unique addition to any collection. 

With the card number P-KP, this sports trading card is manufactured by Panini and is perfect for those who love football. The card showcases Pickett's talent and potential, making it a great investment for any collector. Don't miss the chance to add this rare and valuable card to your collection.
